{{Top|leg}}
'''Denseplast''' was a dense, weighty material that was used in the manufacture of workout balls, a type of exercise device.

[[Conan Antonio Motti/Legends|Conan Antonio Motti]] demonstrated his physical prowess by juggling 3 or 4 denseplast balls in the [[Heavy Gravity Room|heavy gravity room]] aboard the first [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]].
